evidence.title: VantaUI - UI Library Built From Real Products

name: VantaUI
summary: React and Next.js UI library of components, blocks, templates and Figma files, served as a shadcn registry.
description: Production-grade components, interface blocks, site and app templates and Figma files for React 19 and Next.js with Tailwind CSS, browsable by category and style. Items install with the shadcn CLI from a registry, and an MCP server plus llms.txt files let coding agents search and install the catalog.
contains: 124 items in Explore: components, blocks, sites and apps
12 component types incl. 26 buttons, 6 backgrounds, 6 modals and 6 hero sections
components and blocks install with the shadcn CLI
site and app templates download as source; some include Figma files
MCP server for Cursor, Claude and other agents (read-only, token for paid source)
llms.txt, llms-small.txt and llms-full.txt context files
Free plan; Plus $99 and Pro $149 one-time
